description: Add a contact to a customer: pass customer_id, name and email, and optionally external_id (unique within the customer), phone, address and metadata. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as list_customers shows it.

external_id.description: Your own id for the contact, unique within the customer.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: create_contact
